headline: Google's satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
summary: Google's AI chip-equipped satellite successfully booted its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). The on-board Gemma 4 model generated a haiku about space. This marks Google's first AI response from orbit.

headline: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a 'personalized digital menu' at the drive-thru
summary: Starbucks plans to implement AI for personalized digital menus at drive-thrus. The system will recognize customers and offer tailored recommendations. This aims to make ordering and payment more effortless.

headline: The delightfully messy state of Apple gadgets
summary: Apple is currently in a phase of significant gadget experimentation. New features include more iPhone screens and MacBook touchscreens. This period shows Apple trying new things, even if not all results are perfect.

headline: Rivian's autonomy gamble faces its first real test
summary: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe emphasized autonomous vehicle ambitions over R2 SUV production. The company will roll out its point-to-point hands-free driving feature soon. This upcoming release represents a crucial test for their autonomy tech.

summary: The Lenovo Legion Go S Z1 Extreme handheld gaming PC is currently on sale. Shoppers can save $100 using two stackable coupon codes. This deal is available for a limited time this weekend.

summary: Robert Pattinson teases a unique psychological depth in "The Batman Part 2". He states the sequel explores Bruce Wayne's psychology in an unprecedented way. Matt Reeves' film aims to offer a fresh perspective on the character.

headline: HBO's Harry Potter Series Finds Its Sorting Hat, Fat Lady, and Ghosts
summary: HBO has announced casting for key supporting characters in its Harry Potter TV adaptation. Roles like the Sorting Hat, Fat Lady, and various ghosts have been filled. The news comes just in time for Halloween.

summary: Samsung P9 MicroSD Express cards for Nintendo Switch 2 are on sale. Shoppers can save up to 40% on these vetted memory cards. These cards can significantly expand your Switch 2's storage capacity.

headline: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
summary: Binance is working to recover $6.3 billion stolen in a major cyber-attack. The complex hack is believed to be linked to North Korea. This incident is described as potentially the largest crypto hack ever.

headline: What we know about Binance's $6.3bn hack
summary: Cyber correspondent Joe Tidy provides details on the Binance $6.3 billion hack. The incident is suspected to be the largest hack in history. Information about the complex cyber-attack is being shared.

headline: Driver guilty of hitting cyclist and dragging him to death under car
summary: Simon Richardson has been convicted of murdering head teacher Michael Mullins. Richardson hit Mullins with his car and dragged him to death. Sentencing for this crime is scheduled for Monday.

headline: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
summary: Hundreds of residents were evacuated from Oleshky, a Russian-occupied town in Ukraine. The evacuation occurred during a rare ceasefire period. Despite dangers, many people chose to remain in the front-line town.
